title: Unit Event — A Sad Farewell at the Curtain Call — Episode8 How I Feel

meta.Event: A Sad Farewell at the Curtain Call
meta.Event Outline: The next ambassadorial performance is going to be the last one?! Wonderlands×Showtime is staggered to hear the news, but is followed by an offer to do a joint performance with a highly regarded theme park that puts on the best shows in Japan. As chaotic practices ensue, Rui is approached by a certain person...

rows.Line: By the Fountain

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: After we spoke that day, I thoroughly weighed my options... To stay at Phoenix Wonderland as a member of Wonderlands×Showtime...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Or to work alongside you, Asahi, at ArcLand...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And I thought quite a lot about each option in terms of making my dream come true...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: To be completely frank...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If I want to make my dream come true, I should accept your offer, Asahi.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The practices we held together for our performance showed me just how skilled and passionate the cast members of ArcLand are.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's a simple fact that no other place in Japan has such a group at its disposal.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Not only that, but ArcLand provides the perfect working environment for directors. I wouldn't have to make any of my own props...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As a director, moving to ArcLand is what I should do...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: That's quite an expression you've got on your face...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My expression? What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
You know what I mean.
I wish there were a mirror here.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Rui...
Thank you for considering my offer. I'm glad you took the chance to join us seriously.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
But...
I have a feeling that your heart lies elsewhere.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Oh, I see...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I guess this means I...)

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I noticed something when we were practicing together.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: The way you direct is truly egalitarian. You're never biased towards anyone.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: That being said, you show a great amount of trust in everyone from Wonderlands×Showtime.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: You still want to do shows with them, right...?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I wish things could've turned out differently...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Especially since it seems like I failed to make you think, “I want to direct for this guy!”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Which means I still have a long way to go as an actor.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That's not true.
You're already an incredible actor, Asahi.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Haha. Thanks.
But I want to get better for when we meet next time and really make you do a double take.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Asahi...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Still, I understand how you feel...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I was blown away by Tsukasa's acting today. Compared to who I spoke to before the show, it's like he was a completely different person.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Nene and Emu also did an admirable job of keeping up with us.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: If I had friends like that, I'd want to do everything I can to make them shine on stage. I'd want to see how they grow moving forward...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes...
To me, Wonderlands×Showtime is...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A precious jewel that perpetually glows with color and brightness.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: That's a nice expression.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Anyway, I'll ask you again when you graduate from high school.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Until then, Rui, I'll be waiting. On the world's stage...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Asahi...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure you... No, I'm sure all of you will be able to catch up to me in no time.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, we will.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: In that case, let's both keep doing our best. For the sake of our friends!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, let's.
Museum of Emerging Technologies - Main Gate Plaza

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm back, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, Rui...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, there you two are!
Where have you been all this time?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We finished cleaning up what we were assigned to, so we decided to have a little chat. We apologize for disappearing like that partway through.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, it's our last day together, so it makes sense that you wanted to talk. Mind if I ask what the subject was?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, we talked a little bit about the future...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
The future...?
That's awfully vague.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But this show did make me think a little about my own future.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It did?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I realized that my acting skills need a lot of work.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Getting to work with the cast members of ArcLand like this reminded me that the road to stardom is a long one.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, in order to become a world-class star that really shines, I'll need to learn as much as I can from actors like Asahi moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You as well, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
I'll be glad to help you, future star...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Anyway, now that our final ambassadorial performance has come to a close...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let's start thinking about the next show we'll be doing at the Wonder Stage. I already have a mountain of ideas that I want you all to...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, Nene, does this mean...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I'm not sure what happened...
But he seems a lot better now.
Aboard a Train

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe... I can eat lots more...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hnng... My shoulders feel...so heavy...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Sounds like they're having some nice dreams.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? Rui, you're awake?
I thought you'd fallen asleep considering the day we had.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I had a few things on my mind is all. Aren't you going to sleep, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Actually, I've been thinking about a few things as well.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh? May I ask what's on your mind?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The fact that we won't be putting on any more ambassadorial performances. It's been bothering me a little...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Why's that...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As I mentioned a little while ago, this experience gave me an opportunity to learn quite a lot from Asahi and the others...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I suppose it's only natural for skill gaps to appear when performing in shows alongside good actors...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But learning something new topped all of that, and it ended up being very fun.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree.
I had fun as well.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I can tell that you were able to learn several new things while working alongside Asahi this past month, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I knew it! You saying that means the changes I've been feeling are real!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Still, I'm saddened by how our ambassadorial performances are coming to an end. After all, we were able to meet and work with these incredible people because of them...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As a future star, I sure hope that I'll get more opportunities to really grow like this...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But there's no use crying over spilled milk!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We have a duty to fulfill as cast members of Phoenix Wonderland. Let us do what we can for it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Right...
Well...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You have clear goals that you wish to accomplish, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You care deeply about doing your best as a cast member of Phoenix Wonderland and making your own dream come true...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. To be fair, I'm just paraphrasing what somebody else said.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But no one has the right to step on your true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see...
Hearing you say that is very encouraging.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
And yes, you have a point...
For the sake of Phoenix Wonderland, as well as my own dream, it may be good to look at things that way moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yawn... I'm getting sleepy all of a sudden.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You should rest. I'm sure you're very tired after doing two performances today. I'll wake you when we arrive at our station.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Okay, thank you.
Then, I'll be going to sleep for a bit...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...
*Snore*

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe.
What a lively snore.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa's also been thinking about what we'll be doing moving forward...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Sooner or later, we're all going to set out to achieve our own goals...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Things are fun now, but that may change in an instant.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I suspect I'll have moved on by the time that happens.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Or no...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Look at me. When am I going to grow a spine and learn to be more decisive...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (However, I did learn one thing from this experience...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I want to keep doing shows with my friends. More than I previously realized...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (So, for now, I'll keep holding onto both...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (My desire to make my dream come true and my desire to keep putting on shows with my friends.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But it could be possible for us to stay together and make all our dreams come true... I'll try coming up with a way.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Hehe. I'm such a romantic...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But I want to see that future.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (So, I should do everything I can right now to make that happen...)
